Maintain overweight on banks with strong NIMs and fintech lenders; expect continued momentum as IDX liquidity favors small-caps.

Indonesian renewables remain hostage to PLN's monopoly procurement and unresolved feed-in tariff disputes, capping near-term upside for local climate-tech.
Global supply-chain reshoring under the IRA is creating durable margin expansion for US inverter and module makers, a theme absent in Indonesia's import-dependent sector.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US-listed solar/energy storage names (SEDG, ENPH, RUN) on the AI-driven power demand and IRA manufacturing pull-through; avoid Indonesian renewables laggards until tariff clarity and PLN offtake reforms materialize. Trim PLUG exposure on ongoing liquidity risk.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Urban middle-class spending is recovering unevenly, creating durable share gains for brands with strong distribution in tier-2/3 cities over premium-only players.
Digital channel penetration in consumer staples is accelerating, making e-commerce logistics and direct-to-consumer capabilities a lasting competitive moat for FMCG names.
sectors.ai: Buy selective laggards with confirmed volume breakouts (EL, BEEF, IATA) while avoiding crowded momentum names; the sector's aggregate gain masks divergence, so rotate into mid-cap staples with earnings catalysts and hold through Q3 as domestic consumption stabilizes.
